HTTP requests from browser and Node

Make HTTP requests from browser and Node with interceptors, global configuration, mocking and cookie handling. Monitor the axios dependency stack for maintenance, advisories, duplication and unnecessary packages, and compare the role of each candidate with native fetch.

Constraints

  • Actively maintained and responsive to security reports
  • No unfixed high or critical advisories
  • Works in both browser and Node environments
  • Compatible with the existing axios interceptors, global config and mocking approach
  • Permissive license across the full dependency tree
  • No install scripts in the dependency tree
  • Avoid duplicate or unnecessary packages in the axios dependency stack
  • If npm provenance is unavailable, pin exact versions and record the gap

Out of scope

  • Replacing axios with native fetch
  • GraphQL and gRPC transports
  • Detailed performance benchmark against every HTTP client
